overview_description.description:
The Gratuity Calculator UAE provides an online financial tool for calculating end-of-service gratuity payments in accordance with United Arab Emirates labor law. The platform is designed to simplify the process for both employees and employers, offering clarity on financial entitlements at the conclusion of an employment period.

The calculator accommodates various scenarios based on contract types, such as limited and unlimited contracts, and different reasons for termination as stipulated by UAE regulations. The organization aims to offer an accessible and accurate resource for understanding end-of-service benefits within the country's legal framework.
